meta.name: industrial
meta.description: Industrial communication protocols for Zephyr RTOS. Covers Modbus RTU (serial), Modbus TCP (Ethernet/Wi-Fi), and CANopen basics. Trigger when building factory automation controllers, industrial sensors, or medical equipment interfaces.

copy.tagline: 在Zephyr上实现工业通信协议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在使用Zephyr RTOS开发工业通信协议。
copy.tagline_en: Implement industrial communication protocols on Zephyr RTOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing industrial communication protocols on Zephyr RTOS.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你实现基于 Zephyr RTOS 的工业通信协议：Modbus RTU（串行）、Modbus TCP（以太网/Wi-Fi）和 CANopen 基础集成。它会提供代码示例、配置工具和验证清单。
howto.when: 当你需要构建工厂自动化控制器、工业传感器或医疗设备接口时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个 Modbus RTU 服务器，地址为 1。
say.note: Claude 会给出配置代码示例。

say.text: 验证我的 Modbus 寄存器映射表是否有重复地址。
say.note: Claude 会运行寄存器检查脚本。

say.text: 解释 CANopen 对象字典的 PDO 映射方法。
say.note: Claude 会引用参考文档说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help implement industrial communication protocols for Zephyr RTOS: Modbus RTU (serial), Modbus TCP (Ethernet/Wi-Fi), and CANopen basics. It provides code examples, configuration tools, and validation checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building factory automation controllers, industrial sensors, or medical equipment interfaces.

say_en.text: Initialize a Modbus RTU server with node address 1.
Check my Modbus register map for duplicate addresses.
Explain CANopen Object Dictionary and PDO mapping.
